description.sl: Kratke besede -er in the -est, dolge more in the most, nikoli oboje. Za primerjavo than: bigger than Ambleside. Good, better, the best. The oldest in the valley.
description.de: Kurze Wörter -er und the -est, lange more und the most, nie beides. Beim Vergleich than (nicht as): bigger than Ambleside. Good, better, the best. The oldest in the valley.
description.it: Parole corte -er e the -est, lunghe more e the most, mai tutte e due. Nel paragone than: bigger than Ambleside. Good, better, the best. The oldest in the valley.
description.en: Short words take -er and the -est, long ones more and the most, never both. Compare with than: bigger than Ambleside. Good, better, the best. The oldest in the valley.
